title: Satin Brass Double Glass Shelf With Gallery Rail, 22-Inch X 5-Inch Wall Mount, Solid Brass Hardware - Waverly Place Collection, Allied Brass
body_html:
Get countertop-clearing bathroom storage that keeps daily essentials secure—backed by a lifetime warranty — available in Satin Brass, which combines warm golden tones with a brushed texture, bringing modern warmth without the high shine of polished brass. This Waverly Place double glass shelf adds organized space with a protective gallery rail and a clean, concealed-mount look.

  • Satin Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
  • Coordinates beautifully with other Waverly Place hardware in the same finish
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Count on tempered glass strength with 3/8-in thick shelves
  • Choose a coordinated look—part of the Waverly Place collection for matching Waverly Place accessories

Why it lasts: Solid brass hardware outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives for everyday bathroom use.

Specs

  • Product type: Double glass shelf with gallery rail
  • Glass size: 22 x 5 inches
  • Overall dimensions: 22 in (L) x 5 in (projection) x 8 in (H)
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8 in), tempered
  • Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"
  • Warranty: Lifetime warranty

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Waverly Place collection.
meta_description: Double glass shelf with gallery rail for bathroom storage, 22 x 5 inches, wall mount with solid brass hardware and concealed screws. Lifetime warranty.
